items.Sentence: Primary treatment is identical in both systems and consists of mechanical screening, aerated grit removal, and primary sedimentation.

Undisinfected secondary effluent is either stored for agricultural use in a 15-million-gallon pond or blended with treated food processing wastewater and applied directly to agricultural fields.
Secondary effluent in excess of crop demands undergoes tertiary treatment through rapid mixing, flocculation, cloth media filtration, and ultraviolet (UV) disinfection.
